```{r save UMAP function}
save_umap <- function(plot, filename, width = 15) {
  plot <- plot +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 0.75) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 0.75)
  
  ggsave(
    filename,
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = width * 0.75,
    device = "pdf"
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Set your directory containing all Cell Ranger output folders
data_dir <- "/mmfs1/gscratch/kawaldorflab/jcorn427/placenta/placenta_v2/cell_ranger_outs"

# Get all sample folders
sample_folders <- list.dirs(data_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

# Create a named list of data directories
data_dirs <- setNames(
  lapply(sample_folders, function(x) file.path(x, "outs")),
  basename(sample_folders)
)
```
```{r}
# --- Process each sample individually ---
placenta_seuratect_list <- list()
for (sample_name in names(data_dirs)) {
  cat("Processing sample:", sample_name, "\n")
  
  sample_path <- data_dirs[[sample_name]]
  
  # Check if the required directories exist
  raw_path <- file.path(sample_path, "raw_feature_bc_matrix")
  filtered_path <- file.path(sample_path, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
  
  if (!dir.exists(raw_path) || !dir.exists(filtered_path)) {
    cat("Warning: Required matrix paths not found for", sample_name, "- skipping\n\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Try to load and process the data with error handling
  tryCatch({
    # Load raw and filtered data
    cat("  Loading counts...\n")
    raw_counts <- Seurat::Read10X(raw_path)
    filtered_counts <- Seurat::Read10X(filtered_path)
    
    # --- NEW: emptyDrops filtering ---
    cat("  Running emptyDrops...\n")
    set.seed(42)
    e.out <- DropletUtils::emptyDrops(raw_counts)
    
    # Check how many cells are called
    is_cell <- which(e.out$FDR < 0.01)
    cat("  emptyDrops called", length(is_cell), "cells (vs", ncol(filtered_counts), "from CellRanger)\n")
    
    if (length(is_cell) < 100) {
      cat("  Too few cells from emptyDrops, falling back to CellRanger filtered matrix\n")
      filtered_counts <- filtered_counts  # keep as-is
    } else {
      filtered_counts <- raw_counts[, is_cell]  # replace with emptyDrops calls
    }
    # --- end emptyDrops section ---
    
    
    # Check if data is valid
    if (ncol(filtered_counts) == 0 || nrow(filtered_counts) == 0) {
      cat("Warning: No cells or features in filtered matrix for", sample_name, "- skipping\n\n")
      next
    }
    
    cat("  Sample has", ncol(filtered_counts), "cells and", nrow(filtered_counts), "features\n")
    
    # Decide whether to use SoupX based on cell count
    use_soupx <- ncol(filtered_counts) >= 100  # Only use SoupX if >= 100 cells
    
    if (!use_soupx) {
      cat("  Too few cells for SoupX (", ncol(filtered_counts), " cells). Skipping SoupX correction.\n")
    }
    
    soupx_success <- FALSE
    corrected_counts <- NULL
    
    if (use_soupx) {
      # Create preliminary Seurat object for clustering
      cat("  Creating preliminary Seurat object...\n")
      placenta_temp <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = filtered_counts, min.cells = 1, min.features = 1)
      placenta_temp <- NormalizeData(placenta_temp, verbose = FALSE)
      placenta_temp <- FindVariableFeatures(placenta_temp, verbose = FALSE)
      placenta_temp <- ScaleData(placenta_temp, verbose = FALSE)
      placenta_temp <- RunPCA(placenta_temp, verbose = FALSE)
      placenta_temp <- FindNeighbors(placenta_temp, dims = 1:10, verbose = FALSE)
      placenta_temp <- FindClusters(placenta_temp, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)
      prelim_clusters <- placenta_temp$seurat_clusters
      
      # --- Try SoupX correction ---
      cat("  Attempting SoupX correction...\n")
      
      tryCatch({
        sc <- SoupChannel(raw_counts, filtered_counts)
        sc <- setClusters(sc, prelim_clusters)
        # Use more lenient parameters
        sc <- autoEstCont(sc, tfidfMin = 0.5, soupQuantile = 0.9)
        corrected_counts <- adjustCounts(sc, roundToInt = TRUE)
        soupx_success <- TRUE
        cat("  SoupX correction successful!\n")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("  SoupX failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
        cat("  Proceeding without SoupX correction...\n")
      })
    }
    
    # --- Create Seurat object (with or without SoupX correction) ---
    if (soupx_success) {
      fb <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = corrected_counts, project = sample_name)
    } else {
      fb <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = filtered_counts, project = sample_name)
    }
    
    fb$sample <- sample_name
    fb$soupx_corrected <- soupx_success  # Track which samples were corrected
    
    # --- QC for the current sample ---
    fb[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(fb, pattern = "^MT-")
    
    # Check if any cells pass QC
    cells_before <- ncol(fb)
    fb <- subset(fb, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & percent.mt < 5)
    cells_after <- ncol(fb)
    
    if (cells_after == 0) {
      cat("Warning: No cells passed QC filters for", sample_name, "- skipping\n\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Add to the list
    placenta_seuratect_list[[sample_name]] <- fb
    
    cat("Completed:", sample_name, "with", cells_after, "cells (", cells_before - cells_after, "filtered out)",
        ifelse(soupx_success, "(SoupX corrected)", "(no SoupX)"), "\n\n")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("ERROR processing", sample_name, ":\n")
    cat("  ", conditionMessage(e), "\n\n")
  })
}

# Check how many samples were successfully processed
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Successfully processed", length(placenta_seuratect_list), "out of", length(data_dirs), "samples\n")

# Summary of SoupX correction status
if (length(placenta_seuratect_list) > 0) {
  soupx_status <- sapply(placenta_seuratect_list, function(x) x$soupx_corrected[1])
  cat("SoupX corrected:", sum(soupx_status), "samples\n")
  cat("Not corrected:", sum(!soupx_status), "samples\n")
  
  # Show cell counts per sample
  cat("\nCell counts per sample:\n")
  for (sname in names(placenta_seuratect_list)) {
    cat("  ", sname, ":", ncol(placenta_seuratect_list[[sname]]), "cells\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Extract both the animal ID and tissue type, and fix the typo
sample_ids <- sapply(names(placenta_seuratect_list), function(x) {
  # Extract animal ID (J, L, R, Z, A, M followed by digits)
  animal_id <- regmatches(x, regexpr("[JLRZAM]\\d+", x))
  
  # Extract tissue type (more flexible pattern matching)
  tissue <- NA
  if (grepl("_CV_|_cv_", x)) {
    tissue <- "CV"
  } else if (grepl("de[cd]idua|De[cd]idua", x)) {  # Catches both "decidua" and "dedidua"
    tissue <- "Decidua"
  } else if (grepl("[Mm]em[Ii]noc", x)) {
    tissue <- "MemInoc"
  }
  
  # Combine them
  if (length(animal_id) > 0 && !is.na(tissue)) {
    return(paste0(animal_id, "_", tissue))
  } else {
    # Fallback to full name if pattern doesn't match
    return(x)
  }
})

# Now fix the typo in the original placenta_seuratect_list names and sample metadata
for (i in seq_along(placenta_seuratect_list)) {
  old_name <- names(placenta_seuratect_list)[i]
  new_name <- sample_ids[i]
  
  # Update the sample metadata in each object to match the standardized name
  placenta_seuratect_list[[i]]@meta.data$sample <- new_name
}

# Remove the problematic sample from the list before merging
placenta_seuratect_list <- placenta_seuratect_list[!grepl("R06147", names(placenta_seuratect_list))]

# Now merge without that sample
sample_ids <- names(placenta_seuratect_list)

placenta_merged <- merge(x = placenta_seuratect_list[[1]], 
                         y = placenta_seuratect_list[2:length(placenta_seuratect_list)], 
                         add.cell.ids = sample_ids, 
                         project = "all_samples")
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=6}
# scDblFinder requires a SingleCellExperiment object

# Add doublet results back to Seurat metadata

# Get MT percentages

plot2 <- FeatureScatter(placenta_merged, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2

# Subset based on manual thresholds and doublet results
# Note: thresholds should be adjusted based on your specific dataset QC plots

                       subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 &

                                percent.mt < 2.5 & 
                                scDblFinder_class == "singlet")
```

```{r}
# --- SCTransform normalization ---
placenta_merged_filt <- SCTransform(placenta_merged_filt, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt")

# --- Perform PCA on the merged object ---
# It's recommended to run PCA before Harmony
placenta_merged_filt <- RunPCA(placenta_merged_filt, assay = "SCT", npcs = 50)
ElbowPlot(placenta_merged_filt, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")

# --- Visualize PCA results before Harmony (optional) ---
# This plot will likely show clustering by batch/sample
DimPlot(placenta_merged_filt, reduction = "pca", group.by = "sample")
ggsave("pca_pre_harmony_sample.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)

# --- Generate UMAP before Harmony integration ---
placenta_merged_filt <- RunUMAP(placenta_merged_filt, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30, 
                             reduction.name = "umap_preharmony", 
                             reduction.key = "UMAPpreharmony_")
p <- DimPlot(placenta_merged_filt, reduction = "umap_preharmony", group.by = "sample", shuffle = TRUE)
save_umap(p, "umap_preharmony.pdf")

saveRDS(placenta_merged_filt, file = "placenta_merged_pre_harmony.RDS")

# Run Harmony correcting by sample
placenta_merged_filt <- RunHarmony(
  object = placenta_merged_filt, 
  group.by.vars = "sample",
  reduction.use = "pca",
  dims.use = 1:30,
  theta = 2,
  max.iter.harmony = 20,
  verbose = TRUE
)

# Generate UMAP on harmony-corrected embeddings
placenta_merged_filt <- RunUMAP(
  placenta_merged_filt, 
  reduction = "harmony", 
  dims = 1:30,
  n.neighbors = 30,
  min.dist = 0.3
)

# Clustering
placenta_merged_filt <- FindNeighbors(placenta_merged_filt, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
placenta_merged_filt <- FindClusters(placenta_merged_filt, resolution = 0.5)

# Visualize results
p1 <- DimPlot(placenta_merged_filt, reduction = "umap", group.by = "sample") + 
  ggtitle("By Sample - After Harmony")

save_umap(p1, "post_harmony_umap.pdf")

DimPlot(placenta_merged_filt, reduction = "harmony", group.by = "sample")
ggsave("pca_post_harmony_sample.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)
```

```{r}
# Load your reference atlas
atlas <- readRDS("/mmfs1/gscratch/kawaldorflab/jcorn427/placenta/placenta_v2/placenta_seurat_v7.RDS")

# Check what's in the atlas
print(paste("Atlas has", ncol(atlas), "cells"))
print(paste("Cell types:", length(unique(atlas$cell_type_v3)), "unique types"))
table(atlas$cell_type_v3)

atlas <- SCTransform(atlas, vst.flavor = "v2", verbose = TRUE)

# Verify the model is now present
length(slot(atlas[["SCT"]], "SCTModel.list"))  # should be > 0

# Find transfer anchors between your query and reference
transfer_anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = atlas,
  query = placenta_merged_filt,
  normalization.method = "SCT",
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  dims = 1:30
)

# Transfer the cell type labels
predictions <- TransferData(
  anchorset = transfer_anchors,
  refdata = atlas$cell_type_v3,
  dims = 1:30
)

# Add predictions to your object
placenta_merged_filt <- AddMetaData(placenta_merged_filt, metadata = predictions)

# Rename to match your previous naming convention
placenta_merged_filt$predicted.celltype <- placenta_merged_filt$predicted.id

# Now check
head(placenta_merged_filt@meta.data[, c("predicted.celltype")])
table(placenta_merged_filt$predicted.celltype)

# Visualize
DimPlot_scCustom(placenta_merged_filt, reduction = "umap", group.by = "predicted.celltype", 
        label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, label.box = TRUE) +
```

```{r}
# Function to save subset metadata and UMAP coordinates
save_subset_for_scvelo <- function(placenta_seurat, name) {
  # Extract metadata
  metadata <- placenta_seurat@meta.data
  metadata$barcode <- rownames(metadata)
  
  # Extract UMAP coordinates
  umap_coords <- as.data.frame(placenta_seurat@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings)
  umap_coords$barcode <- rownames(umap_coords)
  
  # Merge
  combined <- merge(metadata, umap_coords, by = "barcode")
  
  # Save as CSV
  write.csv(combined, paste0(name, "_metadata.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("Saved metadata for", name, "with", nrow(combined), "cells\n")
}
```

```{r Use Plotly to dynamically lasso cells}
umap_coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(mac_subset, "umap"))
cluster_labels <- as.character(Idents(mac_subset))

ui <- fluidPage(
  plotlyOutput("umap", height = "600px"),
  verbatimTextOutput("selected"),
  actionButton("save", "Save Selected Cells")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$umap <- renderPlotly({
    plot_ly(umap_coords, x = ~umap_1, y = ~umap_2,
            type = "scattergl",
            mode = "markers",
            marker = list(size = 3),
            text = cluster_labels,
            hovertemplate = "Cluster: %{text}<extra></extra>",
            source = "umap") %>%
      layout(dragmode = "lasso")
  })
  
  selected_cells <- reactive({
    event_data("plotly_selected", source = "umap")
  })
  
  output$selected <- renderPrint({
    req(selected_cells())
    paste("Selected:", nrow(selected_cells()), "cells")
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$save, {
    req(selected_cells())
    cells <- rownames(umap_coords)[selected_cells()$pointNumber + 1]
    saveRDS(cells, "gated_cells.rds")
    showNotification("Cells saved to gated_cells.rds")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r Merge #5 with nearest neighbors}
scattered_cluster <- "5"

# Get the UMAP coordinates and cluster identities
umap_coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(mac_subset, "umap"))
cluster_ids <- as.character(Idents(mac_subset))
names(cluster_ids) <- rownames(umap_coords)

# Separate scattered cells from the rest
scattered_cells <- rownames(umap_coords)[cluster_ids == scattered_cluster]
reference_cells <- rownames(umap_coords)[cluster_ids != scattered_cluster]

# For each scattered cell, find the nearest neighbor among reference cells

scattered_coords <- umap_coords[scattered_cells, ]
reference_coords <- umap_coords[reference_cells, ]

nn <- get.knnx(data = reference_coords, query = scattered_coords, k = 1)

# Assign each scattered cell the cluster identity of its nearest neighbor
new_labels <- cluster_ids
for (i in seq_along(scattered_cells)) {
  nearest_cell <- reference_cells[nn$nn.index[i]]
  new_labels[scattered_cells[i]] <- cluster_ids[nearest_cell]
}

# Apply the new labels back to the Seurat object
Idents(mac_subset) <- new_labels

# Visualize to confirm
DimPlot_scCustom(mac_subset, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Macrophage Subset — Scattered Cluster Merged")
```

```{r}
y_range <- range(umap_df_sub1$UMAP_2)

# Step 7: Plot
p_sub1 <- DimPlot(mac_subset,

                          "MemInoc" = "#377EB8"),
                 pt.size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CV" = "#E41A1C",
                                 "Decidua" = "#4DAF4A",
                                 "MemInoc" = "#377EB8"),
                     labels = c("CV" = "Disc",
                                "Decidua" = "Dec",
                                "MemInoc" = "Mem")) +
  geom_density_2d(data = umap_df_sub1,
                  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, group = cluster),
                  color = "black",

                  contour_var = "ndensity",

                   aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = cluster),
                   size = 3,
                   fontface = "bold",
                   fill = "white",
                   alpha = 0.7,
                   box.padding = 0.5,
                   point.padding = 0.3,
                   max.overlaps = Inf,
                   segment.color = "grey40",
                   segment.size = 0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(x_range[1] - padding, x_range[2] + padding)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_range[1] - padding, y_range[2] + padding)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.75, clip = "off") +
  ggtitle("Subset UMAP with cell type labels") +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10))+
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2")
```

```{r Use Plotly to dynamically lasso cells}
umap_coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(t_subset, "umap"))
cluster_labels <- as.character(Idents(t_subset))

ui <- fluidPage(
  plotlyOutput("umap", height = "600px"),
  verbatimTextOutput("selected"),
  actionButton("save", "Save Selected Cells")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$umap <- renderPlotly({
    plot_ly(umap_coords, x = ~umap_1, y = ~umap_2,
            type = "scattergl",
            mode = "markers",
            marker = list(size = 3),
            text = cluster_labels,
            hovertemplate = "Cluster: %{text}<extra></extra>",
            source = "umap") %>%
      layout(dragmode = "lasso")
  })
  
  selected_cells <- reactive({
    event_data("plotly_selected", source = "umap")
  })
  
  output$selected <- renderPrint({
    req(selected_cells())
    paste("Selected:", nrow(selected_cells()), "cells")
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$save, {
    req(selected_cells())
    cells <- rownames(umap_coords)[selected_cells()$pointNumber + 1]
    saveRDS(cells, "gated_cells.rds")
    showNotification("Cells saved to gated_cells.rds")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r Use Plotly to dynamically lasso cells}
umap_coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(tb_subset, "umap"))
cluster_labels <- as.character(Idents(tb_subset))

ui <- fluidPage(
  plotlyOutput("umap", height = "600px"),
  verbatimTextOutput("selected"),
  actionButton("save", "Save Selected Cells")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$umap <- renderPlotly({
    plot_ly(umap_coords, x = ~umap_1, y = ~umap_2,
            type = "scattergl",
            mode = "markers",
            marker = list(size = 3),
            text = cluster_labels,
            hovertemplate = "Cluster: %{text}<extra></extra>",
            source = "umap") %>%
      layout(dragmode = "lasso")
  })
  
  selected_cells <- reactive({
    event_data("plotly_selected", source = "umap")
  })
  
  output$selected <- renderPrint({
    req(selected_cells())
    paste("Selected:", nrow(selected_cells()), "cells")
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$save, {
    req(selected_cells())
    cells <- rownames(umap_coords)[selected_cells()$pointNumber + 1]
    saveRDS(cells, "gated_cells.rds")
    showNotification("Cells saved to gated_cells.rds")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}
# Function to save subset metadata and UMAP coordinates
save_subset_for_scvelo <- function(placenta_seurat, name) {
  # Extract metadata
  metadata <- placenta_seurat@meta.data
  metadata$barcode <- rownames(metadata)
  
  # Extract UMAP coordinates
  umap_coords <- as.data.frame(placenta_seurat@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings)
  umap_coords$barcode <- rownames(umap_coords)
  
  # Merge
  combined <- merge(metadata, umap_coords, by = "barcode")
  
  # Save as CSV
  write.csv(combined, paste0(name, "_metadata.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("Saved metadata for", name, "with", nrow(combined), "cells\n")
}
```

```{r}
# Save metadata for each subset
save_subset_for_scvelo(mac_subset, "mac")
save_subset_for_scvelo(tb_subset, "tb")
```

```{r Use Plotly to dynamically lasso cells}
umap_coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(tb_subset, "umap"))
cluster_labels <- as.character(Idents(tb_subset))

ui <- fluidPage(
  plotlyOutput("umap", height = "600px"),
  verbatimTextOutput("selected"),
  actionButton("save", "Save Selected Cells")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$umap <- renderPlotly({
    plot_ly(umap_coords, x = ~umap_1, y = ~umap_2,
            type = "scattergl",
            mode = "markers",
            marker = list(size = 3),
            text = cluster_labels,
            hovertemplate = "Cluster: %{text}<extra></extra>",
            source = "umap") %>%
      layout(dragmode = "lasso")
  })
  
  selected_cells <- reactive({
    event_data("plotly_selected", source = "umap")
  })
  
  output$selected <- renderPrint({
    req(selected_cells())
    paste("Selected:", nrow(selected_cells()), "cells")
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$save, {
    req(selected_cells())
    cells <- rownames(umap_coords)[selected_cells()$pointNumber + 1]
    saveRDS(cells, "gated_cells.rds")
    showNotification("Cells saved to gated_cells.rds")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}
clusters_of_interest <- c("CTB1", "CTB2", "CTB3", "schCTB", "unknown1", "unknown2", "unknown3", "unknown4")
# Build a lookup of every cluster each gene appears in
gene_cluster_map <- all_markers %>%
  filter(cluster %in% clusters_of_interest) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(other_clusters = paste(cluster, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")

# Then join onto your top markers
top_markers <- all_markers %>%
  filter(cluster %in% clusters_of_interest) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 100) %>%
  distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(gene_cluster_map, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(other_clusters = mapply(function(oc, cl) {
    paste(setdiff(strsplit(oc, ", ")[[1]], cl), collapse = ", ")
  }, other_clusters, cluster))

write.csv(top_markers, "top_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Get the KNN graph
nn_graph <- tb_subset@graphs$SCT_snn

# Get current cell type labels — adjust column name to match yours
cell_labels <- tb_subset@meta.data$cell_type_v5
names(cell_labels) <- colnames(tb_subset)
```
```{r}
schCTB_cells <- which(cell_labels == "schCTB")
new_labels <- cell_labels

for (cell_idx in schCTB_cells) {
  
  # Get neighbors
  neighbors <- which(nn_graph[cell_idx, ] > 0)
  neighbor_labels <- cell_labels[neighbors]
  
  # Exclude other schCTB cells from the vote
  neighbor_labels <- neighbor_labels[neighbor_labels != "schCTB"]
  
  # Majority vote
  if (length(neighbor_labels) > 0) {
    new_labels[cell_idx] <- names(sort(table(neighbor_labels), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  }
}

# Store new labels in tb_subset
tb_subset@meta.data$cell_type_relabeled <- new_labels
```

```{r Use Plotly to dynamically lasso cells}
umap_coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(tb_subset, "umap"))
cluster_labels <- as.character(Idents(tb_subset))

ui <- fluidPage(
  plotlyOutput("umap", height = "600px"),
  verbatimTextOutput("selected"),
  actionButton("save", "Save Selected Cells")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$umap <- renderPlotly({
    plot_ly(umap_coords, x = ~umap_1, y = ~umap_2,
            type = "scattergl",
            mode = "markers",
            marker = list(size = 3),
            text = cluster_labels,
            hovertemplate = "Cluster: %{text}<extra></extra>",
            source = "umap") %>%
      layout(dragmode = "lasso")
  })
  
  selected_cells <- reactive({
    event_data("plotly_selected", source = "umap")
  })
  
  output$selected <- renderPrint({
    req(selected_cells())
    paste("Selected:", nrow(selected_cells()), "cells")
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$save, {
    req(selected_cells())
    cells <- rownames(umap_coords)[selected_cells()$pointNumber + 1]
    saveRDS(cells, "gated_cells.rds")
    showNotification("Cells saved to gated_cells.rds")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r Paper Figures}

umap_df_sub1 <- data.frame(
  UMAP_1  = Embeddings(placenta_seurat, reduction = "umap")[, 1],
  UMAP_2  = Embeddings(placenta_seurat, reduction = "umap")[, 2],
  cluster = placenta_seurat$cell_type_v5,
  tissue  = placenta_seurat$tissue
)
label_coords_sub1 <- umap_df_sub1 %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1), UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2))
x_range <- range(umap_df_sub1$UMAP_1)
y_range <- range(umap_df_sub1$UMAP_2)
padding <- 1.5

# Step 7: Plot
p_sub1 <- DimPlot(placenta_seurat,
                 group.by = "tissue",
                 reduction = "umap",
                 cols = c("CV" = "#E41A1C",
                          "Decidua" = "#4DAF4A",
                          "MemInoc" = "#377EB8"),
                 pt.size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CV" = "#E41A1C",
                                 "Decidua" = "#4DAF4A",
                                 "MemInoc" = "#377EB8"),
                     labels = c("CV" = "Disc",
                                "Decidua" = "Dec",
                                "MemInoc" = "Mem")) +
  geom_text_repel(data = label_coords_sub1,
                  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = cluster),
                  colour = "black",
                  bg.color = "white",
                  bg.r = 0.15,
                  size = 4,
                  fontface = "bold",
                  max.overlaps = Inf,
                  box.padding = 0.5,
                  point.padding = 0.3,
                  segment.color = "grey50",
                  segment.size = 0.3,
                  min.segment.length = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(x_range[1] - padding, x_range[2] + padding)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_range[1] - padding, y_range[2] + padding)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.75, clip = "off") +
  ggtitle("Tissue UMAP with cell type labels") +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2")

# Step 8: Save
w <- 15
ggsave("no_contour_plot.pdf", plot = p_sub1, width = w, height = w * 0.75)
```

```{r}
  tissue  = tb_subset$tissue
)
label_coords_sub1 <- umap_df_sub1 %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1), UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2))
x_range <- range(umap_df_sub1$UMAP_1)
y_range <- range(umap_df_sub1$UMAP_2)
padding <- 1.5
top_padding <- 3.5

# Step 7: Plot
p_sub1 <- DimPlot(tb_subset,
                 group.by = "tissue",
                 reduction = "umap",
                 cols = c("CV" = "#E41A1C",
                          "Decidua" = "#4DAF4A",
                          "MemInoc" = "#377EB8"),
                 pt.size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CV" = "#E41A1C",
                                 "Decidua" = "#4DAF4A",
                                 "MemInoc" = "#377EB8"),
                     labels = c("CV" = "Disc",
                                "Decidua" = "Dec",
                                "MemInoc" = "Mem")) +
  geom_density_2d(data = umap_df_sub1,
                  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, group = cluster),
                  color = "black",
                  linewidth = 0.5,
                  contour_var = "ndensity",
                  breaks = 0.2,
                  adjust = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = label_coords_sub1,
                  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = cluster),
                  colour = "black",
                  bg.color = "white",
                  bg.r = 0.15,
                  size = 4,
                  fontface = "bold",
                  max.overlaps = Inf,
                  box.padding = 0.5,
                  point.padding = 0.3,
                  segment.color = "grey50",
                  segment.size = 0.3,
                  min.segment.length = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(x_range[1] - padding, x_range[2] + padding)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_range[1] - padding, y_range[2] + top_padding)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.75, clip = "off") +
  ggtitle("Subset UMAP with cell type labels") +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2")

# Step 8: Save
w <- 15
ggsave("contour_umap_tb.pdf", plot = p_sub1, width = w, height = w * 0.75)
```

```{r}
Idents(imm_subset) <- "cell_type_v5"
# Generate the base plot without labels
p <- DimPlot_scCustom(
  imm_subset,
  reduction = "umap",
  label = FALSE,
  pt.size = 0.5,
  repel = TRUE,
  colors_use = DiscretePalette_scCustomize(
    num_colors = 33,
    palette = "polychrome",
    shuffle_pal = TRUE
  ),
  color_seed = 42
)

# Check column names if needed: colnames(p$data)

# Compute label positions
label_data <- p$data %>%
  group_by(ident) %>%
  summarise(
    x = median(.data[[grep("_1$", colnames(p$data), value = TRUE)[1]]]),
    y = median(.data[[grep("_2$", colnames(p$data), value = TRUE)[1]]])
  )

# Plot with repelled shadow labels
p2 <- p + geom_text_repel(
  data = label_data,
  aes(x = x, y = y, label = ident),
  colour = "black",
  bg.color = "white",
  bg.r = 0.15,
  size = 4,
  fontface = "bold",
  max.overlaps = Inf,
  box.padding = 0.5,
  point.padding = 0.3,
  segment.color = "grey50",
  segment.size = 0.3,
  min.segment.length = 0.2
)+
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2")
ggsave(
  "umap_plot_imm.pdf",
  plot = p2,
  width = 15,
  height = 10,
  device = "pdf"
)
```

```{r}
# Step 1: Create treatment mapping as a dataframe
treatment_df <- data.frame(
  animal_id = c("Z15006", "A10007", "M10190", "Z12353", "L10152",
                "Z15060", "Z15198", "J08186", "R10195"),
  treatment = c("Media", "Media", "Media", "Media", "Media",
                "Saline", "Saline", "Saline", "Saline")
)

# Step 2: Extract animal ID and join treatment info
meta <- placenta_seurat@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>%
  mutate(animal_id = sub("_.*", "", sample)) %>%
  left_join(treatment_df, by = "animal_id")

# Step 3: Add back to Seurat object
placenta_seurat$animal_id <- meta$animal_id
placenta_seurat$treatment <- meta$treatment

# Verify
table(placenta_seurat$treatment, placenta_seurat$animal_id)
# Step 3: Run scComp
sccomp_result <- placenta_seurat@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>%
  sccomp_estimate(
    formula_composition = ~ treatment,
    .sample = sample,
    .cell_group = cell_type_v5,
    bimodal_mean_variability_association = TRUE,
    cores = 4
  )

# Step 4: Test Media vs Saline
sccomp_result <- sccomp_result %>%
  sccomp_test(contrasts = c("treatmentSaline"))

# Step 5: View and plot results
print(sccomp_result)

# Main results plot - credible intervals
plot_1d <- sccomp_result %>%
  plot_1D_intervals()
ggsave("sccomp_1D_intervals.pdf", plot = plot_1d, width = 10, height = 8)

# Boxplot of proportions per cell type
plot_box <- sccomp_result %>%
  sccomp_boxplot(factor = "treatment")
ggsave("sccomp_boxplot.pdf", plot = plot_box, width = 12, height = 10)
```
